is a normal map that can be played in the survival modes. It was made by Your_Adversary and is medium in length.

takes place at a pier located in a city. The pier itself has a carnival, which contains various attractions like a Ferris wheel, drop tower, bouncing house and carousel. Multiple stores, benches, trash cans and tables can be found. There are also a few advertisements, some of which contain images showcasing other maps. At the back of the carnival, there is a large building with a parking lot, which has multiple Police vehicles, ambulances and other cars parked there. The whole carnival is blocked by a barricade, cutting off the access to the colorful city.

The path begins at the entrance of the large building, which has multiple purple vines coming out of it, and ends at a yellow portal. The path itself is formed in the shape of a plus sign. It avoids various buildings placed on the pier.
